summary: Track daily and weekday habits with local streaks.
page_description: An offline-first habit tracker that puts today's commitments and streaks on a calm paper display.
release_notes: Rebuilt on a renderer that keeps every control reachable at the largest text sizes, and on a keyboard that can type every character this app asks for.
user: Somebody building a routine who wants to mark the day on their Kobo.
job: Track daily and weekday habits and see the streak you are on.
offline: Your habits and their history live on the reader; it never touches the network.

data.kind: your habits and their streak history
data.location: the app's private storage on the reader
data.export: not offered; it is the record the streaks are counted from

non_goals: It does not remind you; it answers when you look.
It does not sync your habits anywhere.
